scope: Read-only inspection of the pinned actual runtime source; no imports, model construction, inference, or code mutation.

findings.result: No per-request stop event or stopping_criteria argument and no **kwargs; stop_strings is the only exposed stop selector. Calls model.generate with an explicit fixed keyword set.
Accepts **kwargs and forwards them to Transformers GenerationMixin.generate, whose documented stopping_criteria parameter is passed to the custom Higgs _sample.

Custom _sample calls stopping_criteria(input_ids_full, scores) after each actual forward/token update; when true the next normal CPU loop iteration does not run. It cannot interrupt an in-flight forward.
AsyncStoppingCriteria(threading.Event) exists and checks is_set(), but no use of that class exists in the selected serve_engine file.

Cancellation before an audio segment exists can leave outputs[1] empty; serve_engine sets waveform None yet still unconditionally indexes outputs[1][0]. Partial delay-pattern audio also enters decode before return. A cancellation implementation must qualify the serve-engine unwind, not merely pass a criterion into the underlying model.

recommendation: A supported per-step criterion exists at model level, but the pinned serving API does not expose it. Assess a version-bounded request-owned bridge or upstream API extension with regression coverage and one bounded real run; do not mutate process-global generation defaults or treat current 96.4s joined Stop as responsive cancellation.
